parties.respondent: The State of West Bengal & Ors.

summary: Fundamental right to fair investigation; refusal to transfer investigation to CBI/SIT; FIRs under IPC sections 341,323,325,326,307,354,504,506,34 due to political-matrimonial feud; petitioner's BJP affiliation vs respondent MP's TMC party; CISF report confirms attack by respondent-led mob; local police restrained from investigation per stay order; alternative remedy via High Court available; no mala fide established for transfer.
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; alternative remedies through High Court upheld; investigation remains with local police pending further orders.
